_note: v2 hook overrides for le palais des glaces (B52_miroirs). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting shows them; these replace only hooks that cannot be painted (nothing may be written) or that differ from what is painted.

fr_fondamental_adj.why: Nothing may be written in the paintings, so the rule is drawn as a crossed-out laughing face instead of chalked words.

fr_serre_adj.why: No tailor is painted; the gentleman with the tape measure gasps the line himself.

fr_gigantesque_adj.why: The painting shows the hamster towering over the doll's desk rather than flattening it.

fr_tenace_adj.why: The painted terrier grips the rope with his paws on the shelf; he is not lifted off the floor.

fr_contraignant_adj.why: The toy train is painted on narrow curling tracks, without a laced corset.
